biotools.summary: Condition-specific Mapping of Operons (COSMO) is a bioinformatics tool for predicting operons in microorganisms using RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) data. COSMO analyzes read coverage across coding sequences and intergenic regions to identify adjacent genes that may be co-transcribed. It uses user-defined coverage thresholds and fold-difference parameters to predict operon structures under specific experimental conditions.
